ex.en: In this way, we waste a lot of time.
ex.zh: 這樣的話我們會浪費很多時間。

ex.en: The time you enjoy wasting is not wasted time.
ex.zh: 你享受浪費的時間，就不算浪費。

ex.en: Tom regretted having wasted a great deal of his life.
ex.zh: 湯姆很後悔自己浪費了大半輩子。

waste.en: to use more of something than you need, or to use it badly

ex.en: The factory waste gave rise to serious environmental pollution.
ex.zh: 工廠廢棄物造成了嚴重的環境污染。

ex.en: Food waste is a big problem in rich countries.
ex.zh: 食物浪費在富裕國家是個大問題。

waste.en: things that are thrown away because they are no longer wanted or useful

ex.en: This meeting is a waste of time.
ex.zh: 這場會議根本是浪費時間。

ex.en: It's a waste to throw away good food.
ex.zh: 把好好的食物丟掉很浪費。

waste.en: the use of more of something than you need, or a bad use of it

ex.en: A covered walkway connects the two buildings.
ex.zh: 一條有遮蔽的走道連接兩棟大樓。

ex.en: Please keep the walkway clear.
ex.zh: 請保持走道暢通。

walkway.en: a path or passage for people to walk along

ex.en: The bank agreed to waive the fee.
ex.zh: 銀行同意免收手續費。

ex.en: He waived his right to a lawyer.
ex.zh: 他放棄了請律師的權利。

waive.en: to choose not to ask for a payment or not to use a right

ex.en: Visiting hours in the ward end at 8 p.m.
ex.zh: 病房的探病時間到晚上八點為止。

ex.en: She works as a nurse on the maternity ward.
ex.zh: 她在產科病房當護理師。

ward.en: a room in a hospital with beds for patients

ward.zh: ward off：防止、抵擋（疾病、危險）

ex.en: Vitamin C may help ward off colds.
ex.zh: 維他命 C 可能有助於預防感冒。

ex.en: He lit a fire to ward off wild animals.
ex.zh: 他生火來驅趕野生動物。

ward.en: to keep something bad or dangerous away

ex.en: We have a warrant to search your apartment.
ex.zh: 我們有搜索票，要搜查你的公寓。

ex.en: The police issued a warrant for his arrest.
ex.zh: 警方對他發出了逮捕令。

warrant.en: an official paper from a court that lets the police do something, such as search a place

ex.en: The situation does not warrant such a strong reaction.
ex.zh: 這個情況不值得反應這麼激烈。

ex.en: His performance warrants a promotion.
ex.zh: 他的表現值得升遷。

warrant.en: to be a good enough reason for something

ex.en: I'm wary of you.
ex.zh: 我對你有戒心。

ex.en: Be wary of emails asking for your password.
ex.zh: 要小心那些要你提供密碼的電子郵件。

ex.en: Investors are wary of risky stocks.
ex.zh: 投資人對高風險股票保持警戒。

wary.en: careful because you think something may be dangerous or wrong

ex.en: There's a Mr Kay who wants to see you.
ex.zh: 有位凱先生想見你。

ex.en: I finally got hold of that book I wanted.
ex.zh: 我終於拿到我想要的那本書了。

ex.en: You may give this picture to whoever wants it.
ex.zh: 你可以把這張照片送給任何想要的人。

want.en: to wish to have something or to see someone

want.zh: want to：想要（做某事）；want sb to：希望某人做

ex.en: "Why aren't you going?" "Because I don't want to."
ex.zh: 「你為什麼不去？」「因為我不想去。」

ex.en: My manager wants me to finish the report today.
ex.zh: 我主管希望我今天完成報告。

want.en: to wish to do something, or to wish that another person will do it

ex.en: That way I kill two birds with one stone.
ex.zh: 這樣我就能一石二鳥。

ex.en: This is the best way to learn English.
ex.zh: 這是學英文最好的方法。

way.en: a method or manner of doing something

ex.en: Could you tell me the way to the station?
ex.zh: 可以告訴我去車站怎麼走嗎？

ex.en: I met Tom on my way to work.
ex.zh: 我在上班的路上遇到湯姆。

way.en: a road or path that you follow to get somewhere

ex.en: British English differs from American English in many ways.
ex.zh: 英式英語和美式英語在很多方面不同。

ex.en: In some ways, he is right.
ex.zh: 在某些方面，他是對的。

way.en: a particular part or point of something

ex.en: By the way, did you call the client?
ex.zh: 對了，你打電話給客戶了嗎？

ex.en: By the way, the meeting has been moved to Friday.
ex.zh: 順便一提，會議改到星期五了。

way.en: used to add a new topic or a small piece of extra information

ex.en: Air is to us what water is to fish.
ex.zh: 空氣對我們，就像水對魚一樣重要。

ex.en: Can I have a glass of water?
ex.zh: 可以給我一杯水嗎？

water.en: the clear liquid that falls as rain and is found in rivers, lakes and seas

ex.en: When was the last time you watered the garden?
ex.zh: 你上次幫花園澆水是什麼時候？

ex.en: The flowers in the garden need watering.
ex.zh: 花園裡的花需要澆水了。

water.en: to give plants or soil the liquid they need to grow

ex.en: He watches at least one movie a day.
ex.zh: 他每天至少看一部電影。

ex.en: I spent Saturday afternoon watching entirely too much TV.
ex.zh: 我星期六下午看了太多電視。

watch.en: to look at something for some time, especially something that is moving

ex.en: Watch your step.
ex.zh: 小心腳步。

ex.en: Could you watch my bag for a minute?
ex.zh: 可以幫我看一下包包嗎？

watch.en: to be careful about something, or to look after someone or something

ex.en: I was given a nice watch by my uncle.
ex.zh: 叔叔送了我一支很漂亮的手錶。

ex.en: My watch is five minutes fast.
ex.zh: 我的手錶快了五分鐘。

watch.en: a small clock that you wear on your wrist

ex.en: The old man walked across the road carefully.
ex.zh: 老人小心地走過馬路。

ex.en: Walking along the street, I met an old friend.
ex.zh: 我沿著街道走時，遇見了一位老朋友。

walk.en: to move on foot at a normal speed

ex.en: When he feels fine, he goes for a walk.
ex.zh: 他心情好的時候會去散步。

ex.en: It is about ten minutes' walk to the station.
ex.zh: 從這裡走到車站大約十分鐘。

walk.en: a trip made on foot for pleasure, or the distance you travel on foot

ex.en: I walk my dog every evening.
ex.zh: 我每天傍晚遛狗。

ex.en: Let me walk you to the station.
ex.zh: 我陪你走到車站吧。

walk.en: to take a dog out for exercise, or to go somewhere on foot with someone

ex.en: We waited in the park for a long time.
ex.zh: 我們在公園等了很久。

ex.en: I'm sorry to have kept you waiting so long.
ex.zh: 抱歉讓你久等了。

ex.en: Hundreds of people were waiting outside the ticket office.
ex.zh: 售票處外面有數百人在等候。

wait.en: to stay in a place or delay doing something until something happens

ex.en: I can't wait to see you.
ex.zh: 我等不及要見到你了。

ex.en: We can't wait for the holidays.
ex.zh: 我們迫不及待想放假了。

wait.en: to be very excited about something that will happen soon

ex.en: There's a two-hour wait for a table.
ex.zh: 要等兩個小時才有位子。

ex.en: The wait was worth it.
ex.zh: 等待是值得的。

wait.en: a period of time spent staying in a place until something happens

ex.en: The paper was beginning to peel off the walls.
ex.zh: 壁紙開始從牆上剝落。

ex.en: There is a portrait of Bob on the wall.
ex.zh: 牆上掛著一幅 Bob 的肖像。

ex.en: He painted all the walls green.
ex.zh: 他把所有的牆壁漆成綠色。

wall.en: a solid upright structure that forms the side of a building or room, or surrounds a space

ex.en: A warm, sunny day is ideal for a picnic.
ex.zh: 溫暖的晴天最適合野餐。

ex.en: Spring is here. It is getting warmer every day.
ex.zh: 春天來了，天氣一天比一天暖和。

ex.en: Put this jacket on, and you'll be much warmer.
ex.zh: 穿上這件外套，你會暖和很多。

warm.en: pleasantly hot, but not too hot

ex.en: Thank you for your warm welcome.
ex.zh: 謝謝你們熱情的歡迎。

ex.en: She has a warm smile.
ex.zh: 她有溫暖的笑容。

ex.en: It has finally stopped snowing and has warmed up.
ex.zh: 雪終於停了，天氣也暖和起來了。

ex.en: I warmed myself in the bath.
ex.zh: 我泡了澡，讓身體暖和起來。

ex.en: I'll warm up the soup for you.
ex.zh: 我幫你把湯熱一下。

warm.en: to become hotter, or to make something hotter

ex.en: Our teacher warned him not to be late again.
ex.zh: 老師警告他不要再遲到。

ex.en: I came to warn you not to do that.
ex.zh: 我是來警告你別那樣做的。

ex.en: Before turning, put on your blinkers to warn other drivers.
ex.zh: 轉彎前要打方向燈提醒其他駕駛。

warn.en: to tell someone that something bad or dangerous may happen

ex.en: Tom left without warning.
ex.zh: 湯姆不告而別。

ex.en: The machine stopped working without warning.
ex.zh: 機器毫無預警地停止運作。

ex.en: Who is that girl waving to you?
ex.zh: 那個在向你揮手的女孩是誰？

ex.en: They waved good-bye to their parents as the train pulled out.
ex.zh: 火車開動時，他們向父母揮手道別。

ex.en: She greeted him waving her hand.
ex.zh: 她揮手跟他打招呼。

wave.en: to move your hand from side to side, or to move something in the air

ex.en: Can you hear the noise of the waves on the beach?
ex.zh: 你聽得到海浪拍打沙灘的聲音嗎？

ex.en: The waves were too big for swimming.
ex.zh: 浪太大，不能游泳。

wave.en: a line of water that rises and moves across the sea

ex.en: A cold wave of fear hit me like a brick.
ex.zh: 一陣恐懼像磚頭一樣狠狠砸向我。

ex.en: A heat wave hit the city last week.
ex.zh: 上週一波熱浪襲擊了這座城市。

wave.en: a sudden increase in a feeling or activity that spreads among many people

ex.en: How often do you wash your car a month?
ex.zh: 你一個月洗幾次車？

ex.en: You haven't washed your hands yet, have you?
ex.zh: 你還沒洗手，對吧？

ex.en: My big sister washes her hair every morning.
ex.zh: 我姊姊每天早上都會洗頭。

wash.en: to clean something with water and soap

ex.en: Mummy has to do the washing this afternoon.
ex.zh: 媽媽今天下午要洗衣服。

ex.en: Your blue shirt is still in the wash.
ex.zh: 你的藍襯衫還在洗。

wash.en: the act of cleaning clothes, or clothes that need to be cleaned

ex.en: I woke up with a headache this morning.
ex.zh: 我今天早上醒來時頭很痛。

ex.en: Sadly, I have to wake up early every day.
ex.zh: 可惜我每天都得早起。

ex.en: I feel as if I've woken up from a nightmare.
ex.zh: 我覺得自己好像剛從惡夢中醒來。

ex.en: I asked Mother to wake me up at four.
ex.zh: 我請媽媽四點叫我起床。

ex.en: Mom wakes me up for school every day.
ex.zh: 媽媽每天叫我起床上學。

ex.en: The minimum wage in Okinawa is 642 yen per hour.
ex.zh: 沖繩的最低工資是每小時 642 日圓。

ex.en: What's the minimum wage in your country?
ex.zh: 你們國家的最低工資是多少？

ex.en: The workers didn't get their basic wage.
ex.zh: 工人拿不到基本工資。

wage.en: money that a worker gets regularly for the work they do

ex.en: The city is waging a campaign against littering.
ex.zh: 市政府正在推動一項反亂丟垃圾的運動。

ex.en: The company waged a long legal battle.
ex.zh: 這家公司打了一場漫長的官司。

wage.en: to start and continue a fight or a big effort

ex.en: Sometimes it's fun to just wander about aimlessly.
ex.zh: 有時候漫無目的地閒逛很有趣。

ex.en: We wandered around the old town all afternoon.
ex.zh: 我們整個下午都在老城區閒逛。

wander.en: to walk around slowly without a clear plan or aim

ex.en: My mind kept wandering during the long meeting.
ex.zh: 冗長的會議中我一直分心。

ex.en: Let's not wander off the topic.
ex.zh: 我們不要離題。

wander.en: to stop paying attention, or to move away from the main subject

ex.en: The invention of the smartphone was a watershed in communication.
ex.zh: 智慧型手機的發明是通訊史上的轉捩點。

ex.en: That meeting proved to be a watershed for the company.
ex.zh: 那次會議後來成了公司的轉捩點。

watershed.en: an event or time that causes an important change

ex.en: The river's watershed covers a huge area.
ex.zh: 這條河的流域面積非常廣大。

ex.en: Protecting the watershed keeps our drinking water clean.
ex.zh: 保護集水區能讓我們的飲用水保持乾淨。

watershed.en: the area of land that sends its rain water into one river

ex.en: Blue light has a shorter wavelength than red light.
ex.zh: 藍光的波長比紅光短。

ex.en: Each radio station broadcasts on a different wavelength.
ex.zh: 每個電台在不同的波長播送。

wavelength.en: the distance from one peak of a wave to the next

wavelength.zh: on the same wavelength：想法一致、合得來

ex.en: My manager and I are on the same wavelength.
ex.zh: 我和主管的想法很合拍。

ex.en: It's easy to work with people on your wavelength.
ex.zh: 跟想法相近的人共事很輕鬆。

wavelength.en: sharing the same ideas and understanding each other well

ex.en: I saw a beautiful waterfall there.
ex.zh: 我在那裡看到一座很美的瀑布。

ex.en: The trail ends at a beautiful waterfall.
ex.zh: 這條步道的終點是一座美麗的瀑布。

ex.en: We took photos in front of the waterfall.
ex.zh: 我們在瀑布前拍照。

waterfall.en: a place where a river falls from a high place to a lower one

ex.en: We stopped at a wayside café for lunch.
ex.zh: 我們在路邊的咖啡館停下來吃午餐。

ex.en: Flowers were growing by the wayside.
ex.zh: 路旁長著花。

wayside.en: the edge of a road or path

wayside.zh: fall by the wayside：半途而廢、被淘汰

ex.en: Many good plans fall by the wayside due to lack of money.
ex.zh: 許多好計畫因缺乏資金而半途而廢。

ex.en: Several start-ups fell by the wayside last year.
ex.zh: 去年好幾家新創公司被淘汰了。

wayside.en: to fail or stop before the end, or to be left behind

ex.en: He is a waiter in a seaside restaurant.
ex.zh: 他在一家海邊的餐廳當服務生。

ex.en: Waiter, please bring me some water.
ex.zh: 服務生，請給我一些水。

ex.en: Soon the same waiter came back to pick up the dishes.
ex.zh: 沒多久，同一位服務生回來收盤子。

waiter.en: a man whose job is to bring food and drinks to people in a restaurant

ex.en: Waitress, I'd like to order.
ex.zh: 服務生，我要點餐。

ex.en: The waitress brought us the menu.
ex.zh: 女服務生拿菜單給我們。

waitress.en: a woman whose job is to bring food and drinks to people in a restaurant

ex.en: The warrior is conscious of both his strength and his weakness.
ex.zh: 戰士知道自己的力量和弱點。

ex.en: A great warrior radiates strength. He doesn't have to fight to the death.
ex.zh: 一名偉大的戰士威力顯著，無需抵死奮戰。

ex.en: In the old story, a brave warrior saved the village from a dragon.
ex.zh: 在古老的故事裡，一位勇敢的戰士從惡龍手中救了村莊。

warrior.en: a brave soldier or fighter, especially in the past

ex.en: One million people lost their lives in the war.
ex.zh: 一百萬人在戰爭中喪生。

ex.en: Why are there still wars in the world?
ex.zh: 為什麼這世界上還有戰爭？

ex.en: Germany was allied with Italy in World War II.
ex.zh: 二次大戰時，德國和義大利結盟。

war.en: a period of fighting between countries or groups

ex.en: The two companies are in a price war.
ex.zh: 這兩家公司正在打價格戰。

ex.en: The government declared war on drugs.
ex.zh: 政府向毒品宣戰。

war.en: a strong fight between people or companies who want the same thing

ex.en: A good warranty would make me feel better.
ex.zh: 有好的保固會讓我比較安心。

ex.en: The laptop comes with a two-year warranty.
ex.zh: 這台筆電有兩年保固。

warranty.en: a written promise from a company to fix or replace a product if it breaks

ex.en: Tom waited for Mary in front of the warehouse.
ex.zh: 湯姆在倉庫前等瑪麗。

ex.en: Who was it that forgot to lock the door of the warehouse?
ex.zh: 是誰忘了把倉庫的門鎖上？

ex.en: Then come with me for a moment. Let's check the warehouse. We might just find it there.
ex.zh: 那您跟我來一下，我們去倉庫找找看，說不定那裡有。

warehouse.en: a large building where goods are stored

ex.en: Warehousing costs increased after the company expanded.
ex.zh: 公司擴大營運後，倉儲成本也提高了。

ex.en: We use a local firm for warehousing and distribution.
ex.zh: 我們委託當地公司處理倉儲與配送。

warehousing.en: the storing of goods in a large building until they are needed

ex.en: Waterproof features would be a plus.
ex.zh: 防水功能會是加分項。

ex.en: The contractor used waterproof sealant around the basement windows.
ex.zh: 承包商在地下室窗戶周圍使用防水填縫劑。

ex.en: Could I have a wake-up call at six tomorrow?
ex.zh: 可以麻煩明天六點叫醒我嗎？

ex.en: I asked the front desk for a wake-up call.
ex.zh: 我請櫃檯提供晨喚服務。

wake-up call.en: a phone call from a hotel to wake a guest at a chosen time

ex.en: The accident was a wake-up call for him to drive more carefully.
ex.zh: 那場意外給了他一記警鐘，讓他開車更小心。

ex.en: Losing the client was a wake-up call for the whole team.
ex.zh: 失去那位客戶給整個團隊敲響了警鐘。

wake-up call.en: something that makes you realize a problem and need to take action

ex.en: I've looked everywhere, but I can't find my wallet.
ex.zh: 我到處都找了，就是找不到我的錢包。

ex.en: Our wallets were stolen.
ex.zh: 我們的錢包被偷了。

ex.en: Tom took out his wallet and paid the bill.
ex.zh: 湯姆拿出錢包付了帳。

wallet.en: a small flat case for carrying money and cards

ex.en: The teacher gave him a warning for being late again.
ex.zh: 老師因為他又遲到而給了他一次警告。

ex.en: There was a warning sign near the river.
ex.zh: 河邊有一塊警告標誌。

ex.en: The storm hit the coast without any warning.
ex.zh: 暴風雨毫無預警地襲擊了海岸。

ex.en: We sat by the fire and enjoyed its warmth.
ex.zh: 我們坐在火堆旁享受它的溫暖。

ex.en: The warmth of the sun made me feel sleepy.
ex.zh: 陽光的暖意讓我昏昏欲睡。

ex.en: She greeted every guest with great warmth.
ex.zh: 她熱情地招呼每一位客人。

ex.en: I was touched by the warmth of their welcome.
ex.zh: 他們熱情的歡迎讓我很感動。

ex.en: Walking is a simple way to stay healthy.
ex.zh: 走路是保持健康的簡單方法。

ex.en: I enjoy walking along the river after dinner.
ex.zh: 我喜歡晚餐後沿著河邊散步。

ex.en: We took a walking tour of the old town.
ex.zh: 我們參加了老城區的徒步導覽。

ex.en: The hotel is within walking distance of the station.
ex.zh: 這間飯店離車站走路就能到。

ex.en: I'll hang the washing outside to dry.
ex.zh: 我要把洗好的衣服晾在外面。

ex.en: Washing the dishes takes me ten minutes.
ex.zh: 洗碗要花我十分鐘。

ex.en: The farmer loaded the wagon with hay and drove into town.
ex.zh: 農夫把乾草裝上馬車，駕車進城。

ex.en: Two horses pulled the heavy wagon up the hill.
ex.zh: 兩匹馬拉著沉重的馬車爬上山坡。

ex.en: The kids pulled their toys around the yard in a red wagon.
ex.zh: 孩子們用一輛紅色的手拉車載著玩具在院子裡走。

ex.en: She put the groceries in the wagon and pulled it home.
ex.zh: 她把雜貨放進手拉車，拉回家。

ex.en: She tied a belt around her waist.
ex.zh: 她在腰間繫了一條腰帶。

ex.en: The water was only up to my waist.
ex.zh: 水只淹到我的腰部。

ex.en: Wales is one of the countries in the United Kingdom.
ex.zh: 威爾士是英國的組成國之一。

ex.en: Cardiff is the capital of Wales.
ex.zh: 卡地夫是威爾士的首府。

ex.en: We went camping in the hills of Wales last summer.
ex.zh: 我們去年夏天到威爾士的山區露營。

ex.zh: 我花了一個早上在澆花園。

ex.en: The smell of fresh bread had my mouth watering.
ex.zh: 新鮮麵包的香味讓我垂涎三尺。

ex.en: The strong onions left my eyes watering.
ex.zh: 強烈的洋蔥味讓我眼淚直流。

ex.en: He wore a waxed jacket to keep out the rain.
ex.zh: 他穿了一件上過蠟的防水外套來擋雨。

ex.en: The shop sells waxed paper for wrapping food.
ex.zh: 那家店賣包食物用的蠟紙。

waxed.zh: 上蠟；打蠟（wax 的過去式）

ex.en: He waxed the car until it shone.
ex.zh: 他把車打蠟打到閃閃發亮。

ex.en: She waxed the wooden floor on Sunday morning.
ex.zh: 她星期天早上給木地板上了蠟。

ex.en: He walked warily past the barking dog.
ex.zh: 他小心翼翼地走過那隻吠叫的狗。

ex.en: She eyed the stranger warily before opening the door.
ex.zh: 她先戒備地打量那個陌生人，才開了門。

ex.en: The two warring countries finally agreed to a ceasefire.
ex.zh: 那兩個交戰的國家終於同意停火。

ex.en: Aid workers helped families trapped between the warring groups.
ex.zh: 救援人員幫助被困在敵對雙方之間的家庭。

ex.en: My uncle has a wacky sense of humor.
ex.zh: 我叔叔的幽默感很古怪。

ex.en: They wore wacky hats to the party.
ex.zh: 他們戴著滑稽的帽子去參加派對。

ex.en: Wang is one of the most common surnames in the Chinese-speaking world.
ex.zh: 王是華語地區最常見的姓氏之一。

ex.en: Mr. Wang is our new math teacher.
ex.zh: 王老師是我們新來的數學老師。

ex.en: I had a waffle with syrup and berries for breakfast.
ex.zh: 我早餐吃了淋上糖漿和莓果的格子鬆餅。

ex.en: The cafe is famous for its crispy waffles.
ex.zh: 這間咖啡廳以酥脆的格子鬆餅聞名。

ex.en: Stop waffling and give me a straight answer.
ex.zh: 別再囉嗦了，給我一個明確的答案。

ex.en: He waffled on for twenty minutes without making a point.
ex.zh: 他講了二十分鐘廢話，卻沒有重點。

ex.en: She waffled over which job offer to accept.
ex.zh: 她對該接受哪份工作猶豫不決。

ex.en: Voters waffle when they don't trust either choice.
ex.zh: 選民對兩個選項都不信任時就會猶豫不決。

ex.en: The factory must clean its wastewater before releasing it.
ex.zh: 工廠必須先處理廢水才能排放。

ex.en: A wastewater plant treats the city's dirty water.
ex.zh: 汙水處理廠負責處理城市的髒水。

ex.en: She served ice cream with a thin vanilla wafer.
ex.zh: 她端上了附有香草薄脆餅的冰淇淋。

ex.en: The priest placed a wafer on his tongue.
ex.zh: 神父把一片聖餅放在他的舌頭上。

ex.en: Chips are made from thin silicon wafers.
ex.zh: 晶片是由很薄的矽晶圓製成的。

ex.en: The factory cuts each wafer into hundreds of tiny pieces.
ex.zh: 工廠把每片晶圓切成數百個小單元。

ex.en: He kept wanting more candy even after dinner.
ex.zh: 他連晚餐後都還一直想吃更多糖果。

ex.en: She left early, wanting to avoid the traffic.
ex.zh: 她提早離開，想避開塞車。

ex.en: The new design was found wanting in several ways.
ex.zh: 這個新設計被發現在幾方面有所不足。

ex.en: His effort was never wanting, even when the task was hard.
ex.zh: 即使任務很難，他也從不缺乏努力。

ex.en: She has long, wavy hair that she never straightens.
ex.zh: 她有一頭從不燙直的長波浪捲髮。

ex.en: The child drew a wavy line across the page.
ex.zh: 那孩子在紙上畫了一條彎彎的波浪線。

ex.en: The teacher patiently guided the wayward student.
ex.zh: 老師耐心地引導那個任性的學生。

ex.en: A wayward ball rolled into the neighbor's yard.
ex.zh: 一顆亂飛的球滾進了鄰居的院子。

ex.en: Wet weather can warp wooden doors over time.
ex.zh: 潮濕的天氣會讓木門日久變形。

ex.en: The floorboards began to warp after the pipe leaked.
ex.zh: 水管漏水後，地板開始翹起來。

ex.en: The warp in the shelf made the books slide off.
ex.zh: 書架的彎曲使書滑了下來。

ex.en: You can see a slight warp in this old record.
ex.zh: 你可以看到這張老唱片有輕微的變形。

ex.en: The new system reduces food wastage in the restaurant.
ex.zh: 新系統減少了餐廳的食物浪費。

ex.en: Water wastage is a serious problem in dry regions.
ex.zh: 水資源浪費在乾旱地區是嚴重的問題。

ex.en: The children were waving flags as the parade passed by.
ex.zh: 遊行經過時，孩子們揮著旗子。

ex.en: She stood at the station waving goodbye to her friends.
ex.zh: 她站在車站向朋友揮手道別。

ex.en: The waving grass moved gently in the wind.
ex.zh: 隨風搖曳的草輕輕擺動。

ex.en: He has long, waving hair that falls past his shoulders.
ex.zh: 他有一頭披過肩膀的波浪狀長髮。

ex.en: I washed the dishes right after dinner.
ex.zh: 我晚餐後馬上洗了碗。

ex.en: He has washed his car every weekend this month.
ex.zh: 他這個月每個週末都洗車。

ex.en: Please use washed vegetables for the salad.
ex.zh: 做沙拉請使用洗過的蔬菜。

ex.en: The washed clothes were hanging in the sun to dry.
ex.zh: 洗好的衣服掛在太陽下晾乾。

ex.en: The old factory site became a wasteland of broken concrete.
ex.zh: 舊工廠的所在地變成一片破碎水泥的荒地。

ex.en: The film is set in a dry and empty wasteland.
ex.zh: 這部電影的背景設在乾燥空曠的荒原。

ex.en: The pigs wallow in the mud to stay cool.
ex.zh: 豬在泥巴裡打滾來降溫。

ex.en: Don't wallow in sadness after a small mistake.
ex.zh: 別因為一點小錯就沉溺在難過裡。

ex.en: The wooden door was warped by the damp weather.
ex.zh: 那扇木門因潮濕的天氣而變形了。

ex.en: He has a warped sense of humor that few people enjoy.
ex.zh: 他的幽默感很扭曲，很少人欣賞。

ex.en: The summer heat warped the old floorboards.
ex.zh: 夏天的高溫使老舊的地板翹曲了。

ex.en: Years of pressure had warped his view of other people.
ex.zh: 多年的壓力扭曲了他對別人的看法。

ex.en: He had a wart on his finger for months.
ex.zh: 他手指上的疣長了好幾個月。

ex.en: The doctor treated the wart with a special cream.
ex.zh: 醫生用一種特殊藥膏治療那顆疣。

ex.en: A warplane flew over the base at high speed.
ex.zh: 一架戰機高速飛越基地上空。

ex.en: The museum displays a restored warplane from the last century.
ex.zh: 博物館展出一架上個世紀的修復戰機。

ex.en: The wanderer slept under the stars each night.
ex.zh: 那位流浪者每晚在星空下睡覺。

ex.en: She was a wanderer who never stayed in one town for long.
ex.zh: 她是個漫遊者，從不在同一個城鎮久留。

ex.en: The boat sailed into calm waters near the island.
ex.zh: 船駛入了島嶼附近平靜的海域。

ex.en: Fishing is not allowed in these waters.
ex.zh: 這片水域禁止捕魚。

ex.en: Waterhouse is an English surname.
ex.zh: 沃特豪斯是一個英國姓氏。

ex.en: The English painter John William Waterhouse is known for his paintings of mythical women.
ex.zh: 英國畫家約翰·威廉·沃特豪斯以描繪神話中的女性而聞名。

ex.en: The waning of the moon means the nights are getting darker.
ex.zh: 月亮漸缺代表夜晚越來越暗。

ex.en: We noticed a slow waning of public interest in the show.
ex.zh: 我們注意到大眾對這個節目的興趣慢慢減退。

ex.en: They danced a slow waltz at the wedding.
ex.zh: 他們在婚禮上跳了一支慢華爾茲。

ex.en: The band played a famous waltz by Strauss.
ex.zh: 樂團演奏了一首史特勞斯的著名圓舞曲。

waltz.zh: 跳華爾茲；輕鬆自在地走

ex.en: The old couple waltzed across the floor.
ex.zh: 那對老夫婦在舞池中跳著華爾茲。

ex.en: He waltzed into the room as if he owned the place.
ex.zh: 他大搖大擺地走進房間，彷彿那裡是他家。

ex.en: Ducks and geese are common waterfowl.
ex.zh: 鴨子和鵝是常見的水鳥。

ex.en: The lake attracts thousands of waterfowl each winter.
ex.zh: 這座湖每年冬天都吸引成千上萬隻水鳥。

ex.en: They made a small wager on the football game.
ex.zh: 他們為那場足球賽下了小小的賭注。

ex.en: I'll take that wager; I think it will rain.
ex.zh: 我接受這個賭注，我認為會下雨。

ex.en: I'll wager that he forgets his keys again.
ex.zh: 我敢打賭他又會忘記帶鑰匙。

ex.en: He wagered ten dollars on the horse.
ex.zh: 他在那匹馬身上下了十美元的賭注。

ex.en: A wandering musician played in the square.
ex.zh: 一位流浪的樂手在廣場上演奏。

ex.en: The wandering cat has no home.
ex.zh: 那隻流浪貓沒有家。

ex.en: After hours of wandering, we found the hidden cafe.
ex.zh: 閒逛了好幾個小時後，我們找到了那間隱藏的咖啡店。

ex.en: His wanderings took him across three countries.
ex.zh: 他的四處漫遊帶他走過三個國家。

ex.en: Please don't waken the baby; she just fell asleep.
ex.zh: 請別吵醒寶寶，她才剛睡著。

ex.en: The loud thunder wakened me in the middle of the night.
ex.zh: 響亮的雷聲在半夜把我吵醒。

ex.en: He wakened early to catch the first train.
ex.zh: 他很早就醒來，趕搭第一班火車。

ex.en: The village slowly wakens as the sun rises.
ex.zh: 太陽升起時，村莊慢慢甦醒過來。

ex.en: The night watchman walks around the factory every hour.
ex.zh: 夜間守衛每小時都會在工廠巡一圈。

ex.en: A watchman opened the gate for us.
ex.zh: 一位看守人為我們打開了大門。

ex.en: The heron is a wader that hunts in shallow water.
ex.zh: 蒼鷺是一種在淺水中覓食的涉禽。

ex.en: Many waders gather on the mud flats in winter.
ex.zh: 許多涉禽在冬天聚集在泥灘地。

ex.en: He put on his waders and stepped into the stream.
ex.zh: 他穿上高筒防水靴，走進小溪裡。

ex.en: Fishermen wear waders to stay dry in the river.
ex.zh: 釣客穿著高筒防水靴，以便在河裡保持乾燥。

ex.en: The waistband of these pants is too tight.
ex.zh: 這條褲子的褲腰太緊了。

ex.en: She tucked her shirt into the elastic waistband.
ex.zh: 她把襯衫塞進有鬆緊帶的褲腰裡。

ex.en: He's just a rock star wannabe who plays in his garage.
ex.zh: 他只是個想當搖滾明星的人，在車庫裡玩音樂。

ex.en: There were many fashion wannabes copying her style.
ex.zh: 有很多想走時尚路線的人在模仿她的風格。

ex.en: The ducks waddle across the road every morning.
ex.zh: 鴨子每天早上搖搖擺擺地過馬路。

ex.en: The toddler waddled toward her mother in a heavy diaper.
ex.zh: 那個學步的小孩穿著厚尿布，搖搖擺擺地走向媽媽。

ex.en: We saw a wallaby hopping through the bush in Australia.
ex.zh: 我們在澳洲看到一隻沙袋鼠跳過灌木叢。

ex.en: A wallaby looks like a small kangaroo.
ex.zh: 沙袋鼠看起來像小型的袋鼠。

ex.en: The baby wallaby stayed safe in its mother's pouch.
ex.zh: 小沙袋鼠安全地待在媽媽的育兒袋裡。

ex.en: She wiped the baby's face with a warm washcloth.
ex.zh: 她用溫熱的小毛巾擦拭寶寶的臉。

ex.en: Please hang the washcloth to dry.
ex.zh: 請把小毛巾掛起來晾乾。

ex.en: The box is watertight and keeps the phone dry.
ex.zh: 這個盒子防水，能讓手機保持乾燥。

ex.en: The lawyer presented a watertight argument.
ex.zh: 律師提出了一個無懈可擊的論點。

ex.en: The walls of our new apartment are painted light blue.
ex.zh: 我們新公寓的牆壁漆成了淡藍色。

ex.en: Tourists can walk along the old city walls.
ex.zh: 遊客可以沿著古老的城牆散步。

ex.en: The wanton destruction of the park made everyone angry.
ex.zh: 公園遭到肆意破壞，讓大家都很生氣。

ex.en: He showed a wanton disregard for safety rules.
ex.zh: 他毫不在乎安全規定。

ex.en: The waterlogged ground made it hard to walk across the field.
ex.zh: 積滿水的地面讓人很難走過那片田地。

ex.en: We could not light the waterlogged wood.
ex.zh: 那些濕透了的木頭根本點不著。

ex.en: The leaves of the plant have a smooth, waxy surface.
ex.zh: 這種植物的葉子表面光滑如蠟。

ex.en: The sick man's face looked pale and waxy.
ex.zh: 病人的臉看起來蒼白如蠟。

watching.zh: 觀看；注視（watch 的現在分詞）

ex.en: I was watching a movie when you called.
ex.zh: 你打電話來時我正在看電影。

ex.en: The children are watching the birds in the yard.
ex.zh: 孩子們正在看院子裡的鳥。

ex.en: We had lunch at a cafe by the waterside.
ex.zh: 我們在水邊的咖啡館吃了午餐。

ex.en: Children played along the waterside until sunset.
ex.zh: 孩子們在水邊玩到日落。

ex.en: Safety is our watchword on every construction site.
ex.zh: 安全是我們每個工地的口號。

ex.en: The guard asked for the watchword before opening the gate.
ex.zh: 守衛在開門前要求對方說出口令。

ex.en: She threw the old letters into the wastebasket.
ex.zh: 她把舊信件丟進廢紙簍。

ex.en: There is a small wastebasket under my desk.
ex.zh: 我的書桌下有一個小廢紙簍。

ex.en: He is trying to reduce his waistline by walking every day.
ex.zh: 他試著每天走路來縮小腰圍。

ex.en: The dress has a high waistline and a long skirt.
ex.zh: 這件洋裝是高腰設計，搭配長裙。
